task: Reconcile the intended worktree, upstream ref, local drafts, tooling, jobs and last hardware receipt.
acceptance: Record exact SHAs and differences. Preserve other checkouts and private backups. Live phone status may be unknown. No mutation is required for this inventory.

task: Classify the four core promises, optional screen input, deferred parity and evidence boundaries.
acceptance: Every advertised flow and version domain has a named proof. Default candidate scope excludes screen capture. Internal distribution scope is explicit.

task: Define the handoff and evidence receipt used by every team.
acceptance: A sample includes work ID, owner, base and output SHA, config/artifact or synthetic fixture digest, environment, assertions, result, invalidation and private receipt pointer.

task: Reconcile the current parity table with the remaining release gates.
acceptance: Read-only Hue Entertainment position import is listed as implemented with physical orientation open. Home coordinates, gradient editing, saved Hue scenes and high-rate streaming are classified separately.

task: Assign writable surfaces, integration owners, worktrees, independent reviewers and private-run reservations.
acceptance: Document who alone edits shared files. A collision, unavailable Mac or missing device permission can park a single lane without claiming a successful test.

task: Open source editing after scope, receipt format and path owners agree.
acceptance: Teams may collect read-only research and synthetic examples while this gate runs. The coordinator grants the first editing claims from the reviewed ownership ledger.
evidence: Dispatch record with owners and file reservations

task: Freeze the minimum shared fixture, sample and time vocabulary for Room, Studio and input.
acceptance: Example request specifies stable scoped fixture IDs, normalized map X/Y independent of phase, monotonic elapsed time, bounded normalized signal and an immutable frame result. No credential or transport in preview values.
evidence: Reviewed signature sketch and sample request/response

task: Make a synthetic household manifest usable by separate test authors.
acceptance: Use fictitious fixtures with duplicate names, different capabilities, a static role, two rooms, a partial Entertainment match and no user identifiers. Specify expected values independently of production code.
evidence: Fixture inventory, generation revision and digest

task: Define expected focus, text and motion behavior before screen integration.
acceptance: Describe a non-color signal label, reachable stop, stable Room focus, long names, static cue stepping, and an explicit distinction between iOS Reduce Motion and physical Reduce Light Motion.

task: Inventory supported schemas, payload size limits and native version/build allocation.
acceptance: Record reproducible expectations for schema-1 section documents, canonical v2 scenes, Scriptable v3 mixes and engine golden schema 2. No schema bump follows solely from the product version.

task: Document which coordinate and membership sources can be read by the installed app, including the CLIP coordinate basis and orientation of the top-view map.
acceptance: Document the published legacy Hue axis convention and current mapper. Record the v2-specific reference or explicit evidence gap. Build a synthetic orientation table. Physical confirmation belongs to Q14.
evidence: Hue and Apple API references, synthetic orientation table, explicit unknowns

task: Define inventory outcomes for no saved configurations, configurations with no usable overlap, and ranked matches with current-room coverage.
acceptance: Fixtures distinguish empty Bridge configuration inventory from unlinked, ambiguous, or out-of-room services. Counts reflect distinct current-room fixtures.
evidence: Discovery contract and sample result table

task: Specify the projection in the existing mapper from the supported Hue coordinate basis to map X/Y.
acceptance: Check asymmetric left/right and front/back pairs against the documented front-at-top convention. Height-only changes preserve top-view position and multisegment fixtures map to one centroid. If v2 evidence differs, revise the projection before acceptance.

task: Produce typed coverage and ranked matches from exact light IDs or unique renderer references. Keep existing deterministic ranking.
acceptance: Two partially overlapping configurations remain separate. Duplicate or malformed references never gain coverage. Unrelated rooms never supply coordinates.

task: Add synthetic discovery tests with full, partial, empty, malformed, duplicated and cross-room fixtures.
acceptance: Tests assert reported outcomes and denominators, ambiguous-ID rejection, and deterministic rank with equal match counts.

task: Add asymmetric orientation and height-only inputs independent of production projection code.
acceptance: Expected points derive from the documented basis and would fail with swapped axes or inverted depth.

task: Return typed discovery results from the pinned Bridge client and preserve transport/authorization failures.
acceptance: GET inventory alone returns successful empty/match outcomes. A failed endpoint or invalid Bridge credential never displays as no saved layouts.
evidence: Mock request method/path and failure assertions

task: Script paired endpoint responses and a failed/incomplete read through the Bridge transport test seam.
acceptance: Exercise both typed GET inventories, valid no-match, endpoint failure, and cancellation without a Bridge. Confirm credential preflight precedes either read.

task: Model scoped discovery on visible idle Room entry with explicit Refresh, task cancellation and invalidation for reconnect, room change, or membership change.
acceptance: Repeated rendering coalesces reads. Delayed results from A to B to A or a refreshed inventory cannot replace the current result. Recovery/playback suppress requests.
evidence: App model scope, retry and cancellation receipt

task: Create a Room discovery card with match coverage, alternate previews, loading, retry, and distinct empty explanations.
acceptance: One match offers a preview directly. Multiple matches are selectable. Ordinary rooms offer manual positioning and explain where Hue Entertainment positions come from.

task: Wire discovery beside the room picker above the map and sliders. Route candidate selection to the existing preview and explicit Save positions.
acceptance: Opening the room surfaces the card before the first fixture control. Cancel preserves the local map and Save applies matching positions only.

task: Expose the match count, candidate name and available action with Dynamic Type and VoiceOver.
acceptance: Long and duplicate area names remain distinguishable. Large text wraps. Candidate and retry actions remain accessible without relying on marker color.
evidence: Accessibility labels and large-text UI cases

task: Add persistence regression coverage through preview, Cancel, explicit Save and reload.
acceptance: On partial import only matched X/Y change. Previous selections, roles, phases, trim, ceilings, absent fixtures and deselected new fixtures survive the full flow. Stale inventory prevents save.

task: Exercise overlapping discovery, room/Bridge identity reuse, inventory refresh, playback transition and retry.
acceptance: A delayed stale response never appears under a new selection. Only one read per generation runs. A fresh retry after failure may succeed.

task: Add deterministic UI cases for a partial match, no saved layouts, no overlap, an unavailable Bridge, and a long name.
acceptance: Coverage, manual positioning, retry, candidate choice and Cancel are reachable with accessibility identifiers and large text.
evidence: XCUI assertions and sanitized rendered evidence

task: Author one read-only device smoke test for the discovery card, real response, optional layout preview and Cancel.
acceptance: Test branches by observed Bridge inventory. Records no-match explicitly. Never taps Save or a light action. Cannot constitute matched-preview proof without a known matching area.
evidence: Authored browse-only DeviceSmoke selector and documented physical prerequisites

task: Define a narrow read seam for the two typed Entertainment inventory loaders. Leave production pinning and credentials inside the Bridge client.
acceptance: Synthetic delayed, malformed, empty and successful reads can be selected without network access or constructing a permissive TLS client.

task: Define a discovery session with an injectable read closure and explicit room, Bridge and inventory-generation identity.
acceptance: An isolated test can supply an arbitrarily delayed reader and rotate the session identity without instantiating the app’s hardwired HueBridgeClient.
evidence: Session API and in-memory delayed reader

task: Integrate the Room changes on the reconciled source revision and hand the compiled browse selector to device qualification.
acceptance: Reviewed source change, reproducible test selectors, oracle and expected results recorded on its revision. List tests actually executed and outstanding Apple runtime proofs. The candidate repeats mandatory runtime gates before installation and promotion.
evidence: Room source integration receipt with separate runtime and physical status

task: Specify one read-only frame request and response for a captured room, draft, optional cue, normalized signal and elapsed seconds.
acceptance: Key by scoped fixture ID. Return effective brightness, modeled display color, Hue target XY, transition and cue position. The pure computation accepts elapsed time as data and has no transport, credential or capture dependency.
evidence: Compile a caller with an injected sampler and a value-only fixture.

task: Build a deterministic fixture and sampler oracle independently of the planner.
acceptance: Two fixtures may share XY and phase but retain distinct IDs, roles, minima, trims and ceilings. Oracle records time, position, gamut and input reads.
evidence: Check fixed hand-calculated RGB, XY and brightness without calling the planner to compute expectations.

task: Resolve selected entries, fresh or cached room scope and effective caps with HueRoomLayout.
acceptance: Use one eligibility rule before input startup, baseline capture, writer acquisition and frame generation. With master 15%, minimum 20% and safety max 80%, exclude that fixture. Accept floor equal to cap, retain compliant neighbors, and fail an all-ineligible room without creating a journal.
evidence: Reducer table plus regression for a 20% minimum, 15% master and 80% global cap. Expect zero planned targets for that fixture in both rehearsal and Live.

task: Define rehearsal time as an absolute monotonic elapsed offset with a bounded endpoint, and reuse HueCueSequence for lookup.
acceptance: At 29.999s and 30s a 30s hold selects successive cues. Backward scrub is deterministic, forward skips missed slots, and elapsed equal to session length reports End without scheduling the next cue.
evidence: Fake-clock cases for endpoints, exact boundaries, fixed-seed shuffle across cycles, invalid elapsed input and an empty or corrupt sequence.

task: Extract role and cue sampling from NativeLiveRunner into the shared frame planner.
acceptance: Moving wash samples phase and cue-local elapsed × speed. Accent adds 0.25 modulo one. Task and anchor sample time zero within each cue. Identical XY never merge fixtures or replace their stored phase.
evidence: Sampler oracle pins accent phase 0.80 to 0.05, two fixture IDs at one XY with different phases, and static roles across cue changes.

task: Extract signal application and target conversion into the same planner.
acceptance: Moving roles use one normalized sample per transition. Static roles ignore it. Physical Reduce Light Motion suppresses it. Preserve gamut-specific XY, trim, ceiling, output limit and global cap.
evidence: Fake signal, two gamuts and capped brightness produce known target fields, distinct design RGB and target XY, and no transport activity.

task: Have NativeLiveRunner consume the evaluated fixture frame through its existing paced submit path.
acceptance: Monotonic duration, one writer, signal-drain cancellation and minimum transition cadence still hold. No frame is submitted after expiry or cancellation during sampling.
evidence: Run HueSpatialFrameTests and PlaybackTransportTests with an injectable monotonic clock, suspended sampler and fake sink.

task: Resolve the rehearsal choice between the saved room, a known empty/ineligible room and the offline demo.
acceptance: Unpaired users see a clearly named sample layout. A real room with zero eligible fixtures shows an explanation. Switching rooms invalidates old fixture IDs without pairing, saving a layout or widening scope.
evidence: App-model tests with two independent fake rooms, an absent room, a changed inventory and a fully ineligible room.

task: Implement paused first-frame, elapsed scrub and previous/next cue as local controls.
acceptance: Every control works offline, honors the bounded endpoint and remains usable without animation. A short session can end inside the first cue.
evidence: Deterministic control tests cover no cues, one cue, shuffle and forward/back boundary steps.

task: Coalesce asynchronous frame requests when the draft, room, cue time or eligibility changes.
acceptance: Only the latest immutable request may publish. Suspending, leaving or switching rooms cancels work. A suspended or failed computation cannot paint a stale frame.
evidence: Barrier-controlled fake sampler returns A after B, plus leave-and-return, sampler error and empty result cases.

task: Render a room map keyed by fixture ID with an accessible equivalent fixture list.
acceptance: Two placements with identical XY remain individually discoverable in the list. Changing only saved XY changes the display placement and preserves engine phase. Color and exclusion use accessible text.
evidence: Synthetic 1, overlapping 2 and many-fixture layouts with long names and maximum Dynamic Type.

task: Connect the room rehearsal and input-preview subviews to Studio in a single integration change.
acceptance: Compose, library Load and custom palette edits update the local preview. Reduced Motion supplies manual stepping. Default idle display activates neither input capture nor physical Live.
evidence: Offline app UI test navigates Scenes → Compose → Studio rehearsal with VoiceOver labels and a stable timeline control.

task: Compare rehearsal targets to a fake Live frame submitted at matching elapsed, signal and room inputs.
acceptance: Compare fixture IDs, dimming, target XY and transition duration to independently calculated cases. Cover shuffled cue boundaries, gamut, overlapping positions, role, cap and cancellation.
evidence: Current-source Apple package pass with individual assertions listed and 512-frame engine digest unchanged.

task: Prove browsing and scrubbing have no side effects through the normal app routes.
acceptance: Repeated scrubs and room/draft changes leave writer count, capture starts and journal mutations at zero. Screen can report an empty, invalid or stale room without falling into Start.
evidence: Injected Bridge-write counter, capture spy and isolated persistence snapshots.

task: Prepare a dedicated browse-only test for rehearsal controls and the room list.
acceptance: Assert first-frame, manual timeline and fixture descriptions at large text and Reduce Motion. Keep screenshot attachments and write-audit activation checks for the device qualification lane.
evidence: Simulator XCTest and staged standalone DeviceSmoke method. Actual paired-device run belongs to the coordinator.

task: Accept the integrated Studio rehearsal source against the qualification candidate.
acceptance: Reviewed source change, reproducible test selectors, oracle and expected results recorded on its revision. List tests actually executed and outstanding Apple runtime proofs. The candidate repeats mandatory runtime gates before installation and promotion.
evidence: Handoff of exact SHA, focused and full-suite results, fixture matrix and browse-only test selector to the release coordinator.

task: Define the local left-to-right phase proposal.
acceptance: Use normalized horizontal position among selected eligible moving fixtures. Equal X values produce equal phases. Ties never depend on input order. All-equal or single-fixture sets get an explicit no-change preview.
evidence: Hand-calculated asymmetric, tied and degenerate examples

task: Author the sweep oracle and preservation cases.
acceptance: Reordered IDs yield the same proposal, excluded/static fixtures retain their phases, local x/y and manual phases remain intact after cancel, and output is within the declared phase interval.

task: Implement fixture-scoped phase calculation as a pure operation on the current map.
acceptance: For distinct moving-fixture X values map equal X to equal phase using sorted distinct ranks k=0…n−1 and phase=k/n. This avoids a duplicated seam at 0 and 1 on a ring. The saved phases also drive an open path. For fewer than two distinct values propose no edits. Preserve caps, selection and static roles.
evidence: Oracle outputs and no-op fixture table

task: Build an explicit preview, cancel and local save operation for a phase proposal.
acceptance: Reject stale map, room or eligibility at save. No implicit phase change on position import or map drag. Reload confirms only the accepted phases.
evidence: Synthetic store save/reload and stale-confirmation case

task: Add a previewable Use positions for sweep action near the room map.
acceptance: Show affected moving fixtures and offer Save phases or Cancel. A degenerate or empty proposal explains why it has no effect.
evidence: XCUI save/cancel, degenerate room and VoiceOver cases

task: Verify stored sweep phases reach the Studio rehearsal and fake Live targets.
acceptance: Cancel preserves manual choreography. Saving changes only the expected phases. A later positional import requires a fresh explicit phase proposal.
evidence: Before/after fake writer frames and read-only preview trace

task: Define the Studio input states for Engine, Microphone and Local media
acceptance: Opening Studio, choosing any source and canceling Files cause zero capture requests, journal changes, writer leases or Hue writes
evidence: Transition table and targeting of existing StudioLiveInputAppTests

task: Adapt the session signal to the shared frame planner and add an independent sample oracle.
acceptance: Reuse S06 for all physical signal math. The adapter delivers the same normalized value to rehearsal for a fixed time and layout. No duplicate runner or amplification logic.

task: Add a session-owned Preview input and Stop preview path that works offline
acceptance: Exactly one sampler owns each session. Repeated taps, cancel during startup and late callbacks cannot start a second session or affect a later one
evidence: Session transition and fake-callback regression cases

task: Bind live microphone metering to explicit Preview or Start and release it on interruption
acceptance: Grant yields normalized RMS in [0,1], denial explains how to change permission, and close, route change, interruption and background drop the tap without automatic restart
evidence: Permission, lifecycle and stale-callback tests with a controlled input

task: Preview a selected local audio or video file using its actual playback position
acceptance: An unpaired user can choose a clip, explicitly preview it, and stop it. EOF or revoked Files access ends sampling and releases security-scoped access after in-flight work
evidence: AVFoundation clip scenarios including audio-only, video-only, combined and inaccessible input

task: Show an accessible level, sampled video color and simulated fixture response in Studio
acceptance: Expose source, level with text and video tint with a description, in an independent Studio subview. At large type or Reduce Motion all actions remain reachable. S12 owns the single LiveView insertion.
evidence: Accessibility assertions and private screenshot recipe using synthetic media

task: Make the transition from Preview to Start explicit and session-safe
acceptance: A preview never writes or saves a baseline. Only an explicit Start can acquire a physical writer and only the matching session can stop it. A failed Start leaves any existing recovery intact
evidence: Fake-client transfer traces covering cancel, failed start and stale completion

task: Keep source sample rates independent of Hue frame submission and preserve output limits
acceptance: Existing ordinary REST cycle is at least max(4500,550 × selected count) ms. No signal modulates a static fixture or crosses master, per-fixture or safety caps. Reduce Light Motion preserves engine-only reactive Start gating
evidence: Boundary tests for multiple fixtures, roles, trim, ceilings, duration and cancellation

task: Extend synthetic media cases to a clip that changes color over time
acceptance: The existing quiet WAV is below 0.05 and the loud change exceeds 0.2. Two known video sections show their expected dominant channels at non-boundary times. Missing media and failed decoding report an actionable outcome
evidence: Deterministic WAV and generated two-color video fixture assertions

task: Test source selection, permissions, preview ownership and cleanup without a Bridge
acceptance: Fakes prove zero Bridge requests from offline preview, zero pending writer and unchanged recovery. Cancel while opening, background/foreground, double-tap and EOF cannot resume capture or submit stale outcomes
evidence: App XCTest scenarios with fake permissions, clock, signal and bridge

task: Exercise the independent preview journey on synthetic content
acceptance: Unpaired launch reaches level and tint, cancel leaves Studio usable, and Dynamic Type and VoiceOver controls expose source, preview state and Stop without issuing a lighting command
evidence: Authored UI checks, manual VoiceOver checklist and expected attachment IDs

task: Prevent accidental replay or personal-file disclosure from saved or transferred Studio state
acceptance: Cold launch and import do not regain media access, open a microphone, reuse an active session or export file paths or audio samples. Persist only explicitly approved portable creative settings
evidence: Cold-launch and export/import state assertions with synthetic filenames

task: Specify device evidence for an explicit bridge-free preview and a separately authorized low-rate Live session
acceptance: Preview protocol requires an active write-audit marker, zero attempts, distinct sound/tint evidence and before/after checksum-valid state. Physical Live protocol binds exact binary, fixtures, brightness limit, duration, single writer, stop and verified restoration or retained unresolved baseline A meter coalesces slow file samples and never increases physical transition rate. Unsupported sources and denied permissions have independent outcomes.
evidence: Frozen-candidate coordinator checklist with separate no-write and authorized-action receipts

task: Hand off the source-ready Studio input changes with runnable test inventory
acceptance: Reviewed source change, reproducible test selectors, oracle and expected results recorded on its revision. List tests actually executed and outstanding Apple runtime proofs. The candidate repeats mandatory runtime gates before installation and promotion.
evidence: Input source review and candidate handoff receipt

task: Define a versioned setup document with an allowlist of portable fields and optional private layouts and safety settings.
acceptance: Schema examples identify section ownership, individual-file compatibility, optional scopes, excluded secrets and device-local state.
evidence: Reviewed format examples and field matrix

task: Freeze synthetic build 6 exports for all seven section types, a canonical v2 scene and a Scriptable v3 mix.
acceptance: Provenance names the build 6 codec revision and generating command. Fixture values, expected IDs and expected warning consent are fixed.

task: Implement the versioned setup envelope, section allowlists and bounded reader.
acceptance: Reject future schema, duplicate section ownership, malformed selections and oversized input before staging. Retain the 512 KiB file and 100-mix limits with a clear split-export remedy.

task: Assign draft engine settings, palette and cue fields to one serialized owner each and define inclusion rules for partial import.
acceptance: Export and import each subset with distinct fixture values. Cue seed shares one owner with the engine seed. Preview discloses its effect. Excluded fields and cue-enabled state survive as specified.

task: Reuse canonical mix merge, legacy conversion and favorites validation.
acceptance: Identical-ID identical-content imports skip. Same ID with different content blocks the selected library. Different IDs with equal display names survive. Favorite replacement and migration warnings appear in review.

task: Plan imports for opted-in room layouts against current room and fixture resource IDs.
acceptance: Same-room matching leaves other placements intact. Offline, foreign and ambiguous rooms are skipped with reasons. A name match never assigns a fixture. Review enumerates each fixture ceiling increase.

task: Plan safety preference changes separately from the global and per-fixture caps used by playback.
acceptance: Show old and new master cap, Reduce Light Motion changes and relevant per-fixture increases before save. Local warning acknowledgement and quarantined evidence survive.

task: Construct an immutable structured review for selected sections and their destination state.
acceptance: An equal-count edit, room switch, safety change, re-pair, or new recovery condition invalidates review at commit. A summary-string match alone cannot authorize a change.
evidence: Stale-review tests with equal display counts

task: Design and implement one local crash-consistent commit for the existing persistent library, favorites, scoped layouts and safety-store data.
acceptance: Fail or restart at every write boundary. A reader sees a complete old or complete committed set after recovery. Physical recovery records and Keychain bytes never enter this transaction.

task: Apply a reviewed setup at idle through one coordinator. Stage memory-only draft, colors and cues separately, and publish to the model after durable success.
acceptance: A failed commit leaves the open draft and stores unchanged. Reload restores persistent sections. Imported draft stays session-scoped until saved as a mix. Unpaired portable sections work offline.

task: Assemble chosen sections for Export setup. Default to portable content and offer explicit inclusion of room identifiers and safety settings.
acceptance: Export while offline works for available sections. List exactly which room layouts are included. Inspect JSON for keychain values, hosts, baselines, consent and security-scoped URLs.

task: Add section selection, import review and confirmation to the existing Files UI.
acceptance: Users can skip conflicting or unmatched sections and rereview other sections. Cancel leaves all data intact. VoiceOver reads old and new ceilings. The original single-section actions remain usable.
evidence: Executed UI selection, cancel, Files and accessibility cases

task: Exercise frozen fixtures across all existing readers and the new setup format.
acceptance: Migrate legacy, import canonically, export a new setup, import twice into an isolated second install and compare normalized results including exact mix IDs and cue timing.

task: Exercise concurrent editor changes and process termination around commit on an isolated synthetic app container.
acceptance: Force termination before staging, during each persist, and after commit before UI publication. Restart preserves the documented state, pairing, baseline and consent and starts no writer.

task: Exercise a clean offline target, matching room and different Bridge with an instrumented fake transport.
acceptance: Preview, import, export, repeat and cancel create zero Hue writes and zero playback leases. Different-Bridge import applies portable sections and reports unmapped layouts.
evidence: App test result and event counters

task: Document section ownership, sharing privacy, fixture identity, old readers, byte limits and transient draft lifetime.
acceptance: Walkthroughs cover moving Studio work to a new Bridge and retaining a draft after restart by saving a mix. Examples use synthetic data.

task: Specify resolution for one or several opted-in room layouts and overlapping or missing scope.
acceptance: Export explicitly selected accessible layouts. A portable document must carry unambiguous original scope for automatic application. If a legacy document cannot establish Bridge identity, require an explicitly reviewed same-area match or skip it. Never remap by display name.
evidence: Two-Bridge sample and legacy resolution decision

task: Serialize setup commit against other setting changes and playback startup.
acceptance: Prevalidate target fingerprints under a local coordinator, distinguish prepared and committed transaction recovery, release on failure and prevent any writer from starting against a mixed configuration.
evidence: Controlled simultaneous import/start/edit tests and restart trace

task: Integrate setup portability in the candidate and provide an evidence index for the release coordinator.
acceptance: Reviewed source change, reproducible test selectors, oracle and expected results recorded on its revision. List tests actually executed and outstanding Apple runtime proofs. The candidate repeats mandatory runtime gates before installation and promotion.
evidence: Transfer matrix indexed by revision and outcome

task: Add independent synthetic vectors for bright flashes, saturated color reversals, corrupt timing and physical Reduce Light Motion.
acceptance: ADR safety envelope, first-use consent and master/fixture caps hold for cues and imported content. Unsafe or unanalyzable dynamic settings fail before the writer. UI Reduce Motion has its own stepping test.
evidence: Safety-policy fixtures and expected fail-closed outcomes

task: Test emergency Turn off now during a suspended frame and immediately around import.
acceptance: Emergency Off preempts ordinary work, covers only journal-eligible fixtures, reports failures, drains stale submissions and retains unresolved baseline for the authorized restore. No automatic restart.
evidence: Fake delayed writer and emergency-stop assertions

task: Define a repeatable end-to-end journey using an isolated synthetic household.
acceptance: Specify a partially matched room, two timed cues, generated nonpersonal clip, export and import into an independent second container. Annotate expected side effects for each action.
evidence: Story script and expected local state delta

task: Author the candidate-only standalone runner scaffold for Files and preview with passive assertions.
acceptance: Keep shared navigation helpers separate from the basic existing-installation selector and the R16/S15 cases. Name synthetic-content and optional local-edit prerequisites. The final hook-up follows actual UI identifiers.
evidence: Named selectors and per-step allowed effects

task: Connect and test the complete recognition, rehearsal, media preview and portable setup story with fakes.
acceptance: The runnable isolated scenario has counters for Hue writes, writer acquisitions and physical-journal mutations, all expected zero, and expected local edits. Record executed source-host results separately from the frozen Q06/Q07 runs.
evidence: Cold-start integration receipt and synthetic snapshots

task: Review capture lifetime, export fields, consent and UI labels across feature boundaries.
acceptance: Inspect synthetic output and aggregate telemetry for personal media, credentials, room IDs without opt-in or raw capture. Verify caps, source names, stop and accessibility behavior across tabs.

task: Bind standalone runner selectors to the integrated accessibility identifiers.
acceptance: List baseline-safe and candidate-only selectors separately. Keep browse-only tests free of Start, Apply, Restore and power taps. Document the isolated, reversible local-edit demonstration.
evidence: Selector map and reviewed screenshots/receipt plan

task: Integrate the reviewed work from the four feature teams on the reconciled branch.
acceptance: Record revision for each accepted patch and independent test. Generate projects only from canonical sources. Resolve shared-file edits through their owner. Create the source integration receipt.
evidence: Merged source SHA, list of changes and remaining runtime gates

task: Freeze an immutable core candidate, marketing version 0.3.0 and next unused build.
acceptance: Reconcile history and reserve the build, resolve default screen scope as excluded, and record commit, lock digest, schemas, safety revision, catalog and signing configurations. Actual artifact hashes are appended after build.

task: Record the installed 0.2.2 baseline before upgrading.
acceptance: Read-only inventory binds app identity, version, build, source receipt, device/OS and transport health. Preserve checksum-valid backup and original baseline. Record a dated blocker if the phone is unreachable or the historical installation was replaced. On future runs record the actual installed version first. Historical build 6 identity is a comparison target, not an assumption.

task: Attempt a separate browse comparison on build 6 before the candidate replaces it.
acceptance: On a reachable, freshly idle build 6 use the standalone runner, compare four tabs, common search and keyboard paths, and capture same-process Debug audit and fresh state. Save a pass, failure, or exact blocker. If the historical binary was replaced, keep its dated receipts and label the comparison unavailable. Never install a downgrade for this comparison.

task: Map release claims and lighting mutators to their evidence.
acceptance: Map every supported flow and lighting HTTP mutator to its Debug attempt hook. Prove a positive control through a synthetic client. Bind microphone, local file audio, local video and any optional screen capability to separate claims.

task: Run clean JavaScript, TypeScript, timing and generator checks on the frozen revision.
acceptance: Frozen lockfile, pinned tool versions, full JS tests, parity subset, TS and timing pass. Regenerated contract has zero tracked diff. Record counts, tool versions and SHA.

task: Run all Swift package tests with Apple JavaScriptCore and strict concurrency.
acceptance: Tests execute on Xcode 27.2 or documented compatible toolchain. Schema 2, eleven places and all 512 frames reproduce the frozen digest. Transport cancellation and writer drain pass. Record failures separately from timeouts.

task: Exercise recovery, scope, import and signal failure cases using fake clients and synthetic media.
acceptance: Executed tests cover partial failure retaining the baseline, XY/mirek quantization and wrong mode, unavailable credentials, conflicting writers, older portable files, invalid inputs, silence and interrupted capture. Failures cannot broaden fixture scope or send a premature command.

task: Run app and UI tests on a functioning simulator at the frozen SHA.
acceptance: xcresult lists executed app and UI assertions and method counts. Include large text, long content, layout, Files review, Studio and offline navigation. Distinguish evidence by runtime and actual matrix. An equivalent isolated iPhone may cover supported UI cases. Reserve the actual alternate host or isolated test phone before use. Keep app-target XCTest away from the protected paired installation.

task: Build a generic iPhoneOS Release archive and inspect its privacy payload.
acceptance: Archive metadata reports 0.3.0 and the chosen monotonic build. Decode the packaged privacy manifest, inspect its API reasons, usage strings, actual capture/storage/network paths and entitlements. Identify unsigned archive status and whether signing was exercised.

task: Build and verify the signed development app and the independent DeviceSmoke runner.
acceptance: Exact SHA and build config, artifact hashes, privacy keys and signing identities match the candidate. Runner is a separate valid signed test bundle without an app dependency. Check phone provisioning privately.

task: Verify fresh idle preflight and update the existing development installation in place.
acceptance: Check exact identity, team and Keychain access continuity and preserve a fresh private backup. Device inventory after installation reports the intended candidate version/build. A fresh checksum-valid copy is idle with no journal or live record. Defer when access or recovery blocks installation.

task: Reconnect and run committed browse-only assertions under the Debug audit.
acceptance: Record ready connection and fresh idle preflight. Require HUE_BOARD_WRITE_AUDIT_ACTIVE before assertions. With the named standalone selector and -collect-test-diagnostics never, capture the entire same-process console, four-tab/search assertions, screenshots and a fresh post-state copy before releasing the phone reservation.

task: Check the candidate's complete browse session and before/after persistence.
acceptance: Read Q11’s preserved console, xcresult and pre/post copies offline. Match one process lifetime, completed assertions, positive activation, zero write attempts, fresh checksums, idle state and no recovery/live records. A truncated run cannot pass.

task: Review the candidate's rendered and assistive navigation.
acceptance: On the audited installation review keyboard, text clipping, scroll reachability, drag and accessible slider alternatives, large type, VoiceOver focus/actions and iOS Reduce Motion. Keep screenshots and a manual assistive checklist with the actual settings and build.

task: Check saved Hue layout discovery and transfer on the paired system.
acceptance: Compare a known physical Entertainment configuration with the available layout, matched fixtures and orientation. Preview and cancel preserve the previous local configuration. Exercise transfer using a synthetic design. Require zero attempts under positive audit and preserve fixture caps and roles. A no-match run qualifies the empty branch only. Obtain a known-direction matched fixture on a suitable setup for the positive branch.

task: Arrange individual bounded hardware sessions for the candidate.
acceptance: Record owner authorization separately for each named room/fixture set, source, actions, maximum duration, ceiling and restore. Check supported hardware, no competing writer, fresh valid idle state and a reachable stop. The app captures the eligible fixtures’ actual baseline immediately before its first mutation in each run. Recheck conditions on every reacquisition.

task: Qualify individual power, brightness and supported color controls with approved fixtures.
acceptance: Capture the authorized scope and applicable baseline. Draft changes leave lamps untouched. Exercise only approved capable actions. Record accepted commands, independent fresh state, observed lamps, restoration and an unaffected fixture.

task: Qualify scoped Studio and cue playback in a separate bounded run.

acceptance: Separate in-app and full-display trials use presentForCurrentApplication() and present(). Picker cancellation leaves the capture idle. Only a returned system filter can start the stream The spike uses its own bundle and container, a null lighting sink and no saved Bridge profile.

task: Reduce display frames to a disposable tint and app audio to a disposable level

acceptance: A reported stream end, error or consent revocation invalidates the session. Unavailable samples expire instead of replaying old values. A valid black image or quiet buffer alone is never treated as proof of protected content

task: Check full-display lifecycle, system stop and protected or unavailable content with physical writes disabled
